findings.detail: Multiple equal-value pairs not marked as ties: rank 42 VT (4) and rank 43 ME (4); rank 44 NV (3) and rank 45 RI (3); rank 46 DC (2) and rank 47 OR (2); rank 48 WA (1) and rank 49 CA (1); rank 50 HI (0) and rank 51 AK (0). All should share ranks with a '(tied)' marker.

Tied groups are given sequential ranks instead of shared rank. AZ/NC/TN all at 2 cities are ranked 3/4/5 (should be 3/3/3). NY through DC all at 1 city are ranked 6-24 rather than sharing rank 6. Systemic rank inflation across the table.

Numerous entries out of monotonic order. E.g., rank 17 OR Portland 630K < rank 18 NV Las Vegas 660K; rank 29 HI Honolulu 340K < rank 30 VA Virginia Beach 452K; rank 32 UT SLC 209K < rank 33 AL Huntsville 225K; rank 36 SC Charleston 155K < rank 37 AK Anchorage 287K; rank 38 MS 145K < rank 39 ID Boise 236K < rank 40 NJ Newark 305K; rank 42 RI 190K < rank 43 SD 202K; rank 47 ME 68K < rank 48 DE 70K; rank 49 WV 48K < rank 50 WY 65K. Many populations violate descending order.

Many capitals ranked below smaller ones. E.g., rank 18 MS Jackson 145K < rank 19 RI Providence 190K < rank 20 ID Boise 236K; rank 22 HI Honolulu 340K placed after Little Rock 202K; rank 24 Jefferson City 43K < rank 25 Saint Paul 300K; rank 29 Tallahassee 202K < rank 27 Sacramento 526K OK but Tallahassee should sort with the 200K cluster earlier; rank 44 Pierre 14K < rank 45 Bismarck 75K; rank 46 Augusta 19K < rank 47 Helena 33K; rank 50 Dover 39K < rank 51 Montpelier 8K OK but pattern is broken throughout.

Descending sort broken repeatedly. Rank 22 LA 72.6% < rank 23 VA 75.5%; rank 24 MN 73.3% < rank 25 NM 74.4% < rank 26 GA 75.5%; rank 28 KS 73.6% ranked after rank 27 MI 74.2% but rank 29 IN 72.1% < rank 30 NE 73.1%; rank 39 IA 63.4% > rank 40 ID 70.6% (ID much higher urban share ranked lower).
TN, OK, and NC all listed at 66.7% urban (ranks 33/34/35) with no (tied) marker or shared rank.

Rank 19 ID 70.6% > rank 20 WI 70.2% (ID has higher urban share = less rural, should rank later); rank 29 VA 75.5% and rank 30 GA 75.5% not flagged as tie; rank 41 SC 68.5% listed after rank 40 ID 70.6% out of order relative to preceding.
NC (14), OK (14 tied), TN (16) all at 66.7% urban — TN not shared with the tie. VA and GA at rank 29/30 both 75.5% not flagged tied.

Multiple large inversions. Rank 15 MO 593 ft < rank 16 MI 727 ft < rank 17 IN 811 ft; rank 18 TN 617 < rank 19 CO 714 < rank 20 WI 833 (WI should be ~top 10); rank 22 AZ 483 < rank 23 NV 735; rank 25 MD 529 < rank 26 VA 508 OK, then rank 28 NM 351 < rank 29 OR 546; rank 30 HI 418 < rank 33 MS 348 OK but rank 33 MS 348 < rank 34 IA 801 (IA should be near top); rank 41 DC 329 < rank 42 DE 395; rank 44 NH 275 < rank 45 ID 323.

Rank 41 DC value labeled 'Washington Monument, non-building 555' — directly contradicts disclaimer restricting to completed buildings (CTBUH classifies the Monument as a non-building structure). Also the value shows '329 ft' rather than 555 ft; the entry is internally inconsistent.
Rank 48 ND value string reads '241 fkt (North Dakota State Capitol, Bismarck)' — typo for 'ft'.

Tied groups given sequential rank numbers instead of shared rank. Ranks 9-10 both 18 HQs (should share rank 9); ranks 12-13 both 14 HQs; ranks 17-19 all 10 HQs; ranks 20-21 both 8; ranks 25-27 all 4; ranks 28-29 both 3; ranks 30-34 all 2; ranks 35-41 all 1. Rank inflation throughout the tail.

Severe ordering break in the middle. Rank 14 OH 6 stations and rank 15 GA 5 stations placed before rank 16 MT 12 stations, rank 17 OR 11, rank 18 CO/IN 10 — MT/OR/CO with 10-12 stations should rank higher than OH (6) and GA (5). OH (6 stations) also duplicates the value of rank 28 LA 6.

Several inversions: rank 5 DC 6.30M > rank 6 PA 6.23M OK but rank 7 GA 6.31M > DC and PA yet ranked below; rank 16 MO 2.80M < rank 17 NC 2.81M; rank 19 TN 2.10M < rank 20 IN 2.14M < rank 21 OH 2.27M < rank 22 NV 2.34M (all should ascend by rank / descend by size); rank 33 NM 0.92M < rank 34 HI 0.99M; rank 38 MS 0.58M < rank 39 NE 0.99M; rank 45 MT 0.19M and rank 46 DE 0.19M tied but not marked; rank 47 AK 0.40M ranked after 0.19M entries; rank 51 VT 0.22M ranked after WY 0.10M. Also rank 32 is skipped entirely (jumps 31 to 33).

Rank 16 lists 21 states all at '1 city' with sequential ties but only NY marked without '(tied)'; the group should either all be rank 16 tied consistently or shown with a single shared marker. Presentation is inconsistent with earlier entries in the same file that use '(tied)'.
Rank 4 DC 20+ colleges placed before rank 5 IL Chicago 22+ colleges — IL has more but ranks lower. Bucket-value format ('X+ colleges') also makes ordering ambiguous throughout.

All values expressed as 'N+ colleges' (open-ended buckets), which makes true ranking non-verifiable — e.g., '10+' at rank 12 (MD Baltimore) and rank 13 (FL Miami) could differ by many actual institutions but appear equal. Disclaimer acknowledges Boston is inflated but doesn't reconcile the plus-notation ordering.
